The '''DataSearch Engine 9C''', also known as the '''TerexComm Deluxe''', was a datasearching device manufactured by [[TerexComm]]. It could be used to search thousands of [[data screen unit]]s quickly.

[[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] discovered that by coupling it with a [[power condenser]], the DataSearch Engine 9C was capable of detecting low-level encrypted files on a system. However, the drawback to the modification was that the increased power demands destroyed programs and [[Scandoc/Legends|scandocs]] that it searched.
